entries.positive_observation: The dark green-black peaked cap retains its source top crop, glossy visor, gold piping and cords, upper gold eagle and separate lower gold wreath/cockade with a red-pale-dark center. Dark eyebrows, one narrow dark upper-lip moustache and a separate small central goatee remain, with exactly one stern closed mouth between them and smooth lateral cheeks and jaw; no glasses, human nose, ears or skin were added. The near-frontal pose, forward gaze, under-visor shadow and original chest crop remain. The dark uniform retains the bright white high standing collar and dark central tie/bow shape. The rounded chin and short broad neck meet the closed collar with continuous contact and no floating cloth, pinching or added cream bib. The full warm gray-beige painted backplate remains through every corner, without a frame, note, halo or replacement studio.
entries.alpha_decision: Approve the RGB art only for a later source-alpha BILINEAR repair. The unchanged return is RGB with returned_alpha_extrema=null, while the source is RGBA with extrema [249,255]; it is not yet approved for production. The complete raw and white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet show no visible backing loss, holes or transparent corners. No alpha repair was performed in this review.
entries.visible_limitations: The cap-emblem interiors, tiny chin-tuft boundary and exact dark necktie/bow construction are not fully separable at 156x210. Their visible major shapes and counts were checked, and no exact unreadable heraldry or writing is claimed.
